rawFindings.title: Incorrect line comparison for determining token offset
rawFindings.explanation: The condition incorrectly compares the 'start.line' of the last token of the previous element instead of the 'end.line' to determine if the range should be offset. This causes incorrect indentation logic for elements that span multiple lines.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change 'sourceCode.getLastToken(previousElement).loc.start.line' to 'sourceCode.getLastToken(previousElement).loc.end.line' to correctly use the end line of the token.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For elements where the last token of the previous element ends on the same line as the start token, the indentation range would be incorrectly set to 0 offset instead of 1 or the configured level, leading to incorrect indentation calculation.
